newsitem.title: USA: Immucor gets FDA questions on new lab tool.
newsitem.headline: Immucor gets FDA questions on new lab tool.

text.p: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has asked Immucor Inc a second set of questions concerning an instrument designed to automate certain blood transfusion compatibility tests, Immucor said Monday..

Immucor developed the instrument it calls the ABS2000 to automate certain labor-intensive, time-consuming tests currently performed by laboratory technologists. The questions came in response to its 510(k) application for market clearance of the instrument.
The company said it would respond to the questions within 30 days, as directed by the FDA.
The company said it received a request for additional clarification of previously submitted materials supporting its application.
It also said it received additional questions and requests for clarification of the instrument design specifications, software, labeling and the products used to run the ABS2000.
On March 18, 1996, Immucor filed its application with the FDA for market clearance. Immucor received initial questions from FDA on December 4, 1996, and responded to FDA on January 6.
